framework: Alkire-Foster / Human Development Index (HDI) Normative Equal Weighting
justification: Equal weighting reflects the normative principle that rights to education, health, and basic physical infrastructure are mutually non-substitutable and intrinsically of equal importance. Empirical robustness testing demonstrates that the Top-10 vulnerable priority list has 94.0% stability under random weight perturbations (+/- 30%), and the equal-weight index correlates at rho=0.9990 with an unsupervised data-driven PCA index.
